test_inputs.explanation: The base_url is taken directly from the URLs the agent navigated to: 'http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/...', so the base is 'http://dockerized-magento.local'. The specific login credentials and text values for gift_message[message] and comment are not visible in the summarized trace (all actions are 'unknown'), so plausible working Magento admin credentials and realistic message/comment texts are provided as testable stand‑ins. The order_id=219 in the URL indicates the agent was viewing an order, but it is not a parameter in the tool schema, so it is not included.
